design_philosophy: Combine the dense calculation environment of a Bloomberg Terminal with the elegant, trustworthy aesthetic of the Financial Times. Reject the modern 'SaaS' look (no gradients, no rounded corners). Use pure geometry, sharp borders, and high-contrast typography.

rules: ALL numbers, inputs, and tabular data MUST use IBM Plex Mono.
Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.
Right-align all numeric data in tables.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, but highly dense for data. Use p-2, p-4 for widgets. p-6, p-8 for outer wrappers.
layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Containers have border-collapse style layout. Items have border-r border-b border-black/20.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: No soft shadows. Use sharp 4px offset solid shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#111111]) ONLY for primary CTAs or active floating elements. Everything else is flat.

hero_kpis.description: Ratio de Compra and Ratio de Venta must be the largest numbers on the screen.
hero_kpis.style: Massive monospace text (text-5xl), color-coded based on cheap/expensive status, sitting in a stark white box with a 1px black border.

data_inputs.description: Editable fields for projections (revenue 2y, fcf 2y, etc).
data_inputs.style: HTML inputs styled via Tailwind. bg-white, border-b border-black border-dashed. Focus: bg-[#F5E4D4] outline-none. No rounded borders. Must feel like a paper form.

tables.style: w-full border-collapse text-left text-sm. Headers in uppercase overline style. Data rows with border-b border-black/10. Hover state: bg-[#F5E4D4].

charts.style: Monochrome lines (#052049) with status-colored areas. CartesianGrid must have strokeDasharray='3 3' and stroke='#11111120'. Tooltips must have sharp borders.

navigation.style: Solid top bar. bg-[#FDF1E6] border-b border-black. Include the app logo and a dense search bar for tickers (USA, .MC, etc).

interaction_and_motion.hover_states: Invert colors for buttons (bg-black text-white to bg-white text-black). Subdued background shift for table rows.
interaction_and_motion.focus_states: ring-1 ring-black ring-offset-1 ring-offset-[#FDF1E6] for accessibility.
interaction_and_motion.animation: Minimalist. Only use for charts (Recharts default) and micro-interactions (instant state changes). No bouncy Framer Motion effects.

app_logo.description: Minimalist abstract logo for the editorial financial dashboard.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, input fields, ticker search, watchlist buttons, and dynamic ratio outputs MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='search-input', data-testid='ratio-compra-value').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Recharts for charting.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for dense layout structures instead of Shadcn Cards to maintain the strict 1px border grid look without rounded corners.
Use Shadcn for complex logic (Dialogs, Selects) but strip out all border-radius (rounded-md -> rounded-none).
Implement the specific formulas for Ratio de Compra and Ratio de Venta exactly as described.
Ensure the layout supports a side-by-side comparison mode for multiple companies.
Use localStorage for the watchlist functionality.
Build the editable input grid to allow the user to override auto-fetched data and instantly recalculate the heroes (Ratio de Compra/Venta).
